boamp_fr.name: boamp_fr
boamp_fr.title: BOAMP, public procurement notices 2022-2023 (IDENTITE schema)
boamp_fr.real_text_note: yes (values and free text are real; 'Label : value' layout rendered by us)
boamp_fr.gold_type: exact by construction: e-mail, phone, fax and street address fields of every party block; contact person names extracted from the CONTACT/CORRESPONDANT fields by a rule (civility and role removed)

review.summary: Gold reviewed by hand on two random samples of 50 notices (seeds 20261025 and 20261026). The second sample was drawn after the contact-parsing fixes and is the estimate for the gold used here. Lines of codes, amounts, criteria and titles were hidden in the second review.
review.sample_1_before_fixes: seed 20261025: 9 of 50 documents with a personal-gold error; 15 errors for about 481 personal mentions (3.1%): 12 missing (contact names written with a role or an e-mail, a lawyer awardee labelled as an organisation, street addresses typed inside a name or ID field), 2 wrong labels (a postcode-only line labelled as a street address), 1 boundary (a service name inside the address field). Fixed: contact parser (civilities, roles, several persons, e-mails and phones inside the field), awardee with a civility labelled PERSON, house-number rule for addresses, address typed in the ID field.
review.sample_2_after_fixes: seed 20261026: 6 of 50 documents with an error; 6 errors for 287 personal mentions (2.1%, 95% Wilson interval 1.0-4.5%): 4 missing (a name after 'Monsieur le Président', a sole-trader awardee written 'Surname Given-name' without civility and labelled ORG, two street addresses typed in the city field or glued to 'Hôtel de Ville'), 1 wrong (a tunnel name with a department number labelled as a street address), 1 boundary (unit names inside the address field). Not fixed, to keep this sample an unbiased estimate.

bodacc_fr.name: bodacc_fr
bodacc_fr.title: BODACC, commercial announcements naming natural persons
bodacc_fr.real_text_note: yes (record values and free text are real; line layout rendered by us after bodacc.fr)
bodacc_fr.gold_type: exact by construction: values of the structured fields (surname, given names, address, RCS/RM number) are rendered at known positions; exact repeats of a person's name elsewhere in the notice are added; owner addresses in the fixed 'Adresse de l'ancien/du nouveau propriétaire :' phrase are added

review.summary: Gold reviewed by hand on two random samples of 50 announcements (spotcheck_real.py, seeds 20261025 and 20261026). The first review found errors that were fixed by rule; the second, fresh sample measures the gold used here.
review.sample_1_before_fixes: seed 20261025: 8 of 50 documents with a personal-gold error; 8 errors for about 263 personal mentions (3.0%): 2 boundaries ('(EI)' marker inside the name span), 6 names written inside a trade name and missing from the gold. Fixed: '(EI)' excluded, names and given names searched inside trade names.
review.sample_2_after_fixes: seed 20261026: 0 of 50 documents with an error in the scored zone (0 of 274 personal mentions; 95% Wilson upper bound 1.4%). One owner address written 'Adresse ancien propriétaire' (no 'de l'') was missed in free text (ignored zone, outside precision); the phrase rule was widened afterwards.

judilibre_fr.name: judilibre_fr
judilibre_fr.title: Judilibre (Cour de cassation, cours d'appel, tribunaux judiciaires), negative control
judilibre_fr.real_text_note: yes (decisions pseudonymised by the courts before publication)
judilibre_fr.gold_type: none: parties are already replaced by '[X]'-style placeholders; detections are reviewed by hand

review.summary: No gold: 120 masked spans drawn at random over the 300 decisions (4,153 masked spans in all; spotcheck_real.py --detections --detection-contexts 120, seed 20261025) and classified by hand with their context.
review.residual_personal_data_correctly_masked: 82/120 (68.3%): 78 names of magistrates, court clerks and lawyers (left in clear by the court pseudonymisation), 3 birth dates of parties written 'né(e) le <date>' next to a pseudonymised name, 1 residence name next to a street address
review.false_positives: 38/120 (31.7%, 95% Wilson interval 24.0-40.4%): 27 company, brand or law-firm names masked as a person or organisation (international brands, insurers, SCI and SAS names, 3 law firms), 6 capitalised common words taken for a name ('doit' twice, 'Faisant', 'Premier', 'Constitué', 'de Chambre'), 2 restaurant name mentions, 1 grape variety, 1 hiring date taken for a birth date, 1 legal reference ('R. 3211-18, R. 3211') masked as an address. Recounted by an independent reviewer: same totals (82/38); two law-firm names made of lawyers' surnames are counted here as false positives, while SCP names are counted as residual data, a debatable boundary worth +-2 spans
review.placeholders: No court placeholder ('[E]', '[Adresse 1]', '[Localité 4]') was masked in the 120 drawn spans
